description: This file defines a Loader component using LightningJS framework. It provides a visual loading indicator with animated circles, manages a fade-in/fade-out transition via an alpha state, and sets up an interval to toggle the transition.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays animated circles as a loading indicator, managing fade transitions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the interval that toggles the alpha property to animate the loader's fade-in and fade-out effect.
